text: A bookmark saves the exact state of a report page — filters, selections, even which visuals are showing. Here's how to put that to work.
Turn on the Bookmarks pane from View, get the page looking exactly how you want it captured, and select Add.

Power BI names it automatically — rename it right away to something meaningful. And under More options, you control exactly what it restores: filters and slicers, visual visibility, even whether it navigates to a specific page at all.
The real payoff: attach a bookmark to a button. Toggle Action on, set Type to Bookmark, pick the one you want — now selecting that button resets filters or switches views in one click.
Group several bookmarks together, and View plays just that group as a slideshow — a guided walkthrough, no clicking required. Last lesson of the chapter: analytics, forecasting, and advanced visuals.
